introTitle.text: Section 91.141 Flight restrictions in the proximity of the Presidential and other parties

info.text:
• Situations that might results in the issuance of a Section 91.141 TFR.
  • These TFRs are issued for protection of the President, the Vice President, or other important public figures, including candidates for president and vice president.

• No person may operate an aircraft over or in the vicinity of any area to be visited or traveled by the President, the Vice President, or other public figures contrary to the restrictions established by the Administrator and published in a Notice to Airmen (NOTAM)
